purpose: Post-hoc decomposition of every frozen proposal query, not a repaired generator or causal/perceptual labels.
population: All forty original inputs and all 3348 original queries, including empty candidates and unavailable reference. Previous source, input, candidate, slice and result hashes are checked; no query filtering.
matching: Chronological one-to-one 60 ms tolerance matching, not least-error alignment. Fixed half-open query with a 60 ms halo; candidate halo clips to physical clock support. Cross-boundary matches are constructive witnesses, not proof of the absence of another alignment.
boundary_only: An original miss with at least one crossing pair and no unmatched central reference or candidate tick under the fixed halo alignment. Does not update the strict original result.
offset_compatible: At least one equal-count ordered candidate has residual span at most 120 ms. No offset is selected or applied. Translating can change crop membership, so this is not repaired coverage.
anchor_inventory: Raw-event/reference local halo alignment identifies missing and extra query events. Missing reference anchors are separately matched one-to-one to existing model local-max candidates; this is not joint event selection or a recoverable-coverage bound.
interval_inventory: Full-trace raw/reference chronological matching supplies endpoint reference indices. Count reference-index advances in intersecting raw intervals; unmatched endpoints remain unknown. Measure interior query reference ticks more than 60 ms from uniform endpoint interpolation. Neither mixed advances nor nonuniform residuals proves a musical tempo change or a specific causal failure.
aggregation: Mutually exclusive query partitions use the stated precedence. Failed-query flags are nonexclusive; anchor totals count repeated occurrences in overlapping queries, not independent unique events. Keep per-input and old post-hoc slice counts.
budget: One descriptive replay after authored geometry tests and this lock; no new candidate, phase fitting, threshold sweep, optimizer, audio acquisition, listening or heldout data. Reference-assisted findings can motivate a separate proposal only.
